lines.text: GTA six aa gaya. Aur internet pe sabse zyada ek hi sawaal search ho raha hai: GTA six price in India.
Seedha jawab pehle: game ₹5,999 ka. Aur agar PS5 bhi lena hai, to poora setup ₹70,989 se shuru.
Lekin ruko. Zyaadatar log isse paanch hazaar rupaye zyada de rahe hain, ek aisi cheez ke liye jo GTA ke dabbe mein hai hi nahi.
Aaj hum game, console, internet, EMI aur PC ka wait, sab ka hisaab khud lagayenge. Aur end mein bataayenge GTA six khelne ka sabse sasta tareeka.
Chapter ek. Game ka daam.
PlayStation India pe do edition hain. Standard ₹5,999 , aur Ultimate ₹7,499 .
Farak ₹1,500 ka. Aur us pandrah sau mein kya milta hai? Extra gaadiyan, hathiyaar, kapde aur safehouse business. Kahani wahi hai. Ek bhi extra mission wali story nahi.

Dono edition ke saath Vintage Vice City pack aata hai. Aur jinhone 20 November se pehle digital pre-order kiya, unhe ek mahine ka GTA plus free mila. Ab khareedoge to wo free mahina nahi milega. Aur jinke paas hai, dhyaan rakhna: mahina khatam hote hi GTA plus apne aap renew hota hai, jab tak aap cancel na karo.

Ab sabse mazedaar baat. Dukaan pe jo GTA six ka dabba milta hai, uske andar disc nahi hai. Sirf ek download code hai. Blinkit gyaarah shehron ke kuch ilaakon mein ye dabba minuton mein de raha hai, lekin khol ke milega code hi.
Yaad rakhna, ye baat chapter do mein paise bachayegi.
Chapter do. Console ka kharcha.
GTA six sirf do console pe hai: PS5 aur Xbox Series X aur S. PS4 aur Xbox One pe nahi chalega. PC version abhi announce hi nahi hua.
Ab PS5 ke daam dekho. Amazon India pe October ke aakhir mein PS5 Slim digital ₹64,990 ka tha, aur disc wala ₹69,985 ka.
Aur ye wahi PS5 hai jo kuch time pehle ₹54,990 ka milta tha. Matlab disc wala lagbhag 27% mehenga ho chuka hai. Sony ne wajah batayi manufacturing, memory aur storage ki badhti keemat.
Ab jodo. Digital PS5 plus Standard game: ₹70,989 . Disc PS5 plus Standard: ₹75,984 .

Yahan hai hook wala twist. Disc drive ke liye aap ₹4,995 extra de rahe ho. Lekin GTA six ke dabbe mein disc hai hi nahi. Toh agar aap sirf GTA ke liye PS5 le rahe ho, to disc drive pe paanch hazaar lagaana zaroori nahi.
Haan, agar aap purani discs khelte ho, ya game bech ke paise wapas lena chahte ho, to disc wala kaam ka hai. Faisla aapka, lekin ab hisaab saamne hai.

Aur Xbox? Microsoft ne is saal duniya bhar mein Xbox ke daam badhaaye. Series S ab America mein paanch sau dollar ke upar hai. India ka naya daam humein kisi pakke source mein nahi mila, isliye hum andaaza nahi lagayenge.
Chapter teen. Do sau baarah GB ka hisaab.
PlayStation store ke mutabik GTA six ke liye kam se kam 212 GB khaali jagah chahiye.
Aapke PS5 mein ek TB storage hai. Matlab akela GTA poori storage ka paanchva hissa kha jaata hai. Purane games delete karne padenge.
Xbox Series S wale aur dhyaan dein. Uski storage 512 GB hai. GTA akela lagbhag 41% le lega. Pehle jagah khaali karo, phir download shuru karo.
Ab internet ki baat. Do sau baarah GB download karne mein kitna time lagega?
Agar aapka net sau Mbps ka hai, aur poori speed milti hai, to lagbhag 4 ghante 43 minute .
Chaalees Mbps ka net hai, to lagbhag 11 ghante 47 minute . Raat bhar chhod do.
Chhota sa tip: PS5 ko rest mode mein chhod do. Rest mode mein bhi download chalta rehta hai, aur subah game ready milega.
Aur agar aap socho ki phone ke do GB roz wale plan se hotspot karke download kar loge, to 106 din lagenge. Sach mein. Teen mahine se zyada.
Toh GTA six se pehle ek achha WiFi plan bhi budget mein jodo.
Lekin kya PC ke liye dedh saal rukna samajhdaari hai? Uska asli sach, agle chapter mein.
Chapter chaar. PC ka wait karein?
Bahut log keh rahe hain, main PC pe khelunga. Problem ye hai ki Rockstar ne PC version ki koi date nahi di. Agle saal ki shuruaat wali baat sirf afwaah hai.
Itihaas dekho. GTA five console pe September 2013 mein aaya tha. PC pe April 2015 mein. Yaani lagbhag 19 mahine baad.
Agar Rockstar wahi gap dohraye, to GTA six PC pe lagbhag June 2028 ke aas paas aayega. Ye prediction nahi, sirf pichhla pattern hai.
Rockstar ka doosra bada game dekho, Red Dead Redemption two. Console pe October 2018 , PC pe November 2019 . Yaani lagbhag 13 mahine.
Toh dono pattern milaao, to GTA six PC pe kahin December 2027 se June 2028 ke beech aa sakta hai. Phir se, ye sirf pattern hai, Rockstar ki date nahi.
Aur PC ke liye graphics card kitna chahiye, ye bhi abhi official nahi hai. Internet pe jo specs ghoom rahe hain, wo purane leak hain.
Toh seedhi baat: agar aapke paas pehle se strong gaming PC hai aur aap dedh-do saal ruk sakte ho, to wait theek hai. Warna wait ka matlab hai, sab dost khelenge aur aap spoiler dekhoge.
Chapter paanch. Mahine aur ghante ka hisaab.
Sattar hazaar ek saath bhaari lagte hain. Agar aap baarah mahine ki no cost EMI pe lo, to ₹5,916 mahina. EMI offer bank aur dukaan ke hisaab se badalte hain, isliye ye sirf hisaab hai.
Ab ek aur tareeka. Maan lo aap saal bhar roz ek ghanta khelte ho. Matlab 365 ghante.
Poora setup, ₹70,989 , ka matlab lagbhag ₹194 rupaye ghanta.
Aur agar PS5 pehle se hai, to sirf game ka kharcha ₹16 rupaye ghanta. Ek chai se bhi kam.

Aur agar aap sirf weekend gamer ho? Saturday aur Sunday do-do ghante. Matlab hafte mein chaar ghante, saal mein 208 ghante. Tab poora setup lagbhag ₹341 rupaye ghanta padta hai, aur sirf game lagbhag ₹29 rupaye ghanta.
Aur PS5 pe aap baaki games bhi kheloge, to asli per ghanta kharcha isse bhi kam hoga.
Aur ek desi jugaad. Teen dost milke ek PS5 aur ek game lo, aur baari baari se khelo. Har ek ka hissa ₹23,663 . Bas ye pehle tay kar lena ki Saturday raat kiski baari hai.
Chapter chhe. Duniya mein kya hua.

Pehle kahani. GTA six mein do lead hain, Jason Duval aur Lucia Caminos. Ye pehla numbered GTA hai jisme female lead hai. Game Leonida mein set hai, jo Florida ka nakli roop hai, aur saath mein naya Vice City. Reports ke mutabik map GTA five se lagbhag do guna bada hai, lekin Rockstar ne official number nahi diya.

Kya game paise layak hai? Critics ka jawab: haan. Metacritic pe 99 , ek sau pachaas se zyada reviews se. Ye Zelda Ocarina of Time ke 1998 wale record ki barabari hai. IGN aur GameSpot ne das mein se das diye.
Paisa bhi barsa. Sensor Tower ke andaaze se launch se pehle hi lagbhag 17.07 million digital pre-order, aur $1.65 billion ki kamai. Ye andaaze hain, Rockstar ne official number abhi nahi diye.
Lekin sab kuch perfect nahi. Launch se ek din pehle PSN down hua. Kuch players ne prologue mein crash, Lucia ke shuruaati mission mein game atakna, aur gaadiyon ki ajeeb physics ki shikaayat ki.
Aur console pe game tees frame per second pe locked hai. Reviewers ki sabse badi shikaayat yahi rahi.
Chapter saat. Faisla.
To bahas mein ye teen number bolo.
Ek: PS5 pehle se hai, to GTA six ₹5,999 ka. Ultimate ke pandrah sau extra sirf saamaan ke liye hain, kahani ke liye nahi.
Do: naya lena hai, to sabse sasta tareeka hai digital PS5 plus Standard game, ₹70,989 . Dabbe mein disc hai hi nahi, toh sirf GTA ke liye disc drive pe paanch hazaar mat lagao.
Teen: PC ka wait karna hai, to Rockstar ke pichhle pattern se ek se dedh saal ka wait ho sakta hai.
Ab aapki baari. PS5 abhi loge, ya PC ka wait karoge? Comment mein A ya B likho. A matlab abhi PS5, B matlab PC ka wait.
Aise hi har trending sawaal ka poora hisaab chahiye, to Doubt Clear subscribe kar lo.
